title: Add Cache-Control headers for CDN support
description:
Port caching headers from local branch to optimize CDN and client caching.

**Changes (src/server.rs):**
- API/OAuth/inbox/health: no-store (never cache)
- Discovery (WebFinger, NodeInfo): 5 min, must-revalidate
- Actor docs, collections: 1 min, must-revalidate
- Profile/post pages: 1 min
- RSS/Atom feeds: 5 min
- Media files: handled by reverse proxy (immutable)

**Patch:** ~/PROJECT/smallhold/0001-feat-Cache-Control-headers-for-CDN-support.patch
close_reason: Already applied and verified — patches deleted
